newsitem.title: USA: Fed refrains from open market operations.
newsitem.headline: Fed refrains from open market operations.

text.p: The Federal Reserve refrained from open market operations on Tuesday, dealers said.
At 1130 EST/1630 GMT, the time when the Fed usually intervenes in the market, federal funds were traded at 5-3/16 percent, below the Fed's 5-1/4 percent target.
Analysts said the market is still expecting the Fed to add permanent reserves to the banking system through a coupon pass operation soon, but not necessarily on Tuesday.
